interpretation: All retained prompt and captured reply bodies in these nine files were read in their preserved order, including the full terminal log after a display truncation.
Forty-seven bodies exactly match original stored native input_text parts. Absence of retained_source metadata is not a declaration of truncation or of complete pre-retention history.

A request to execute a repair received only a plan. Operation equivalence is not success or outcome equivalence.

Full external documents, earlier handoff ancestry and current external completion claims are not newly verified by this review.
